slides.s: Engineering Leader | AI-Driven Transformation | 21+ Years in Software & DevOps
slides.n: Please welcome {name}, a PMP-certified engineering leader with 21 years of experience, including 8 years in engineering management. {His} career spans software development, testing, DevOps, and AI-enabled engineering transformation across global technology companies.

items: F5 Innovation India · Jul2025-Sep2026 — Led a 10-member team on BIG-IP control plane services, cut upgrade time by ~90%, drove security hardening and remediation of 100+ CVEs, and led development of 7-8 AI agents for automated issue resolution.

Cisco Systems · Mar2020-Jul2025 — Led Webex developer experience team; architected distributed presence and calling integration between Webex and Microsoft Teams using Kafka, Redis, and Java, and drove AI-based code generation for Webex SDKs.

Cisco Systems · Apr2018-Feb2020 — Led developers, testers, and release engineers on Cisco Expressway, driving Python/C++ platform features, Erlang-based database upgrades, and DevOps release engineering.

Cisco Systems · Apr2008-Feb2018 — Owned functional, regression, and automation testing for Cisco Call Manager and Expressway, drove automation coverage toward 100%, and handled customer escalations with SIP/H.323/RTP troubleshooting.

Verizon & Alcatel · May2007-Apr2008 — Performed end-to-end call-flow and regression testing for IP-converged contact center solutions and Alcatel OmniPCX PBX systems, ensuring product quality across releases.
slides.n: {His} journey began in QA, testing VoIP and PBX systems at Verizon and Alcatel, before {he} spent a decade at Cisco strengthening test automation and troubleshooting complex call-control features. {He} then moved into leadership, guiding teams through platform modernization, distributed architecture, and eventually pioneering agentic AI adoption at F5, where {he} now drives security and automation initiatives.

{Name}'s technical foundation blends deep engineering leadership with hands-on expertise in AI, cloud, and networking protocols. {His} PMP certification and 8 years of management experience are paired with practical skills in Python, Java, and agentic AI systems that {he} has personally driven into production.

items: Test automation coverage achieved at Cisco
slides.n: Across {his} career, {name} has delivered measurable impact — from cutting upgrade time by nearly 90% at F5, to resolving over 100 long-standing security defects, to driving test automation coverage to 100% at Cisco. These results reflect a consistent focus on reliability, security, and efficiency.

{Name} continually invests in {his} own growth — from an early engineering degree in Electronics and Communication, to a PMP certification supporting {his} leadership career, to a recent postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Texas at Austin, reflecting {his} ongoing commitment to AI-driven transformation.

That concludes {name}'s journey — from hands-on QA engineer to AI-driven engineering leader. With deep technical expertise and a passion for innovation, {he} continues to build high-performing teams and transform how software is delivered. Thank you for your time.
